# TABLES
customers (4,000 rows; one row per customer)
  customer_id VARCHAR -- unique customer key, customer_city VARCHAR -- city of the customer, customer_region VARCHAR -- one of North/South/East/West/Central, signup_date DATE -- date the customer registered, acquisition_channel VARCHAR -- organic, paid_search, social, email, affiliate
sellers (180 rows; one row per seller (marketplace merchant)
response:
```sql
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_region,
        p.product_category,
        r.review_score,
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_purchase_ts) AS quarter
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status <> 'canceled'
      AND DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_purchase_ts) IN ('2025-04-01', '2025-07-01')
)
SELECT
    customer_region,
    product_category,
    quarter,
    ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM base
GROUP BY
    customer_region,
    product_category,
    quarter
ORDER BY
    customer_region,
    product_category,
    quarter;
```
